access.notes: Python wrapper for the MSIS-90 empirical atmosphere model. Provides number density profiles n_i(z) for O, N₂, O₂.

Charge exchange, electron stripping, ionization, and excitation cross sections for H⁺ and H on O, N₂, O₂. Energy loss parameterizations from Basu et al. (1993, doi:10.1029/93JA02180). Data must be digitized or coded from published tables/functional forms.
